solution_summary: Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency, a Public Sector organization in United Kingdom, modernized this customer service automation workload with Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, Azure App Service, and Azure Application Insights. However, by 2019, the leadership team at the DVSA wanted to bring management of the service inhouse to achieve greater control over a number of factors. Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides the case management and service workspace used by support teams. Microsoft Teams acts as the collaboration surface where users consume insights, copilots, and workflow updates. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics so business users can act on fresher insights. Data from theory test service is ingested into Dynamics 365 Customer Service, processed across Microsoft Teams, and surfaced through Power BI so teams can act on fresher operational insight.

“It’s easy to say ’97 percent of people are catered for and that’s good enough’. However, we, as a team, decided that isn’t good enough,” explains Alex Fiddes. “We have a responsibility to give everyone a great service.”
. We were able to run 5,000 tests on day one. We pulled off this hugely ambitious project with an inflexible deadline and that’s a massive credit to both the people involved and the technology.”

The scalability of Microsoft Azure and Dynamics 365 has proved to be of enormous benefit to DVSA. Before the pandemic, when the platform was first being planned, the DVSA theory testing service delivered 2.4 to 2.6 million tests per annum.
By the time the inhouse platform went live, and the nation came out of the pandemic, annual demand for theory tests had increased to 3.6 million.
